---
title: "Overview"
---

This Quarto **book** is the narrative companion to the analysis scripts
under `scripts/`. R chunks stay `eval: false` until artefacts exist.
Mermaid and static Markdown still execute; [`freeze: auto`](https://quarto.org/docs/projects/code-execution.html#freeze)
caches those results in `docs/_freeze`.

The layout follows analysis reproducibility repos such as
[cellrank2_reproducibility](https://github.com/theislab/cellrank2_reproducibility)
(Python + Jupyter Book there). Here the stack is **R**, **`renv`**, and
**Quarto**, published with the GitHub Pages `gh-pages` workflow
([Quarto: GitHub Pages, Knitr with renv](https://quarto.org/docs/publishing/github-pages.html#example-knitr-with-renv)).

The scientific target is DeCovarT's cell-type Gaussians: sparse
precisions $\boldsymbol{\Theta}_{j}\equiv\boldsymbol{\Sigma}_{j}^{-1}$ and means
$\boldsymbol{\mu}_{\cdot j}$ estimated from labelled single-cell
transcriptomes, then plugged into the bulk convolution. Notation follows
the article Methods. Computation stays in `scripts/`; this book is
theory, criticism, and design.

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-cap: "Planned pipeline: GEO gastruloids, method-conditional observation model, core GGMs, type-level alignment, feature panels, DeCovarT, then precision-matrix contamination. Fused and copula-joint graphs stay in the GRN appendix."

flowchart TD
  A["GEO GSE229513 UMI"] --> B["Preprocess SE / SCE"]

  D -->|yes| E["NPN inside SILGGM / low-rank / GmGM"]
  D -->|no| F["Raw counts PLN"]
  E --> G["Sparse SPD Theta_j"]
  F --> G

  H --> I["DeCovarT deconvolution"]

  G -.-> K["Appendix: FGL, JGCGM"]
```

## How to render

From the repository root, after `renv::restore()`:

```bash
quarto render docs
# first time only, once gh-pages is allowed:
# quarto publish gh-pages docs
```

The book format is **HTML only** for now (`pdf` is commented in
`docs/_quarto.yml`). CI publishes HTML to the `gh-pages` branch.

## Scripts (source of truth for computation)

| Script | Role |
|--------|------|
| `scripts/01_01_single_cell_exploration_suppinger.R` | Explore GSE229513 |
| `scripts/02_01_deconvolution_preprocessing.R` | Harmonise genes; SE / SCE |
| `scripts/03_01_grn_silggm.R` | SILGGM GGM (NPN **inside this branch**) |
| `scripts/03_02_grn_blggm.R` | BLGGM mixture GGM (optional given labels) |
| `scripts/04_01_feature_selection_pseudobulk_deseq2.R` | Naive screen (no DE $p$-values without biological replicates) |
| `scripts/04_02_feature_selection_genetic_algorithm.R` | Pareto gene panel |
| `scripts/05_01_sensitivity_precision_contamination.R` | Misspecify $\boldsymbol{\Theta}_{j}$ |
